paper.title_en: Interacting Galilean and Finite-Energy Carroll Fermions
paper.abstract_en: We develop a common similarity-transformation framework for Galilean and Carrollian Dirac contractions, encompassing Lévy--Leblond and magnetic Carroll spin-half systems. Explicit field maps relate free formulations with different mass and energy parametrizations. We obtain the complete five-parameter family of derivative-free Hermitian quartic potentials for a pair of Grassmann-odd Pauli spinors, invariant under rotations, a common $U(1)$, and triangular boosts. Higher-order and color-mixed interactions admit exact classical solutions. An independent pairing channel generates derivative interactions upon exact auxiliary elimination and sources otherwise absent Carroll spinor components. Quartic deformations of a Galilean fermionic gauge theory yield algebraic or spatial differential equations while preserving a local phase symmetry. Nambu--Jona-Lasinio contractions provide relativistic origins for selected channels.
